decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster system fits closely with the firm's established pumping and coolant-management know-how, and its survival through 2024 suggests the firm can learn from early field use and improve it within its existing engineering and service capabilities.

The coolant cleaning centrifuge builds directly on the firm's filtering and process-media expertise, so high related knowledge and likely customer feedback from metalworking users make continued refinement and retention more likely than withdrawal.

The scraper belt chip conveyor is highly adjacent to the firm's long-standing conveying and automation business, and continued website presence indicates commercially usable learning that supports keeping it in the range.

The hinged belt chip conveyor sits squarely in the firm's core competence in material-flow and chip-handling systems, so absorptive capacity is strong and the product is likely to remain while being incrementally improved.
